newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bankers Trust NZ 6-month profit NZ$12.28 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust NZ 6-month profit NZ$12.28 mln.

text.p: Bankers Trust New Zealand Ltd (BTNZ) said on Monday its net surplus for the six months to June 30 was NZ$12.28 million.
The result was released under the Reserve Bank's disclosure requirements.

A comparative year-ago figure was unavailable because the first half of 1995 pre-dated the requirement to disclose, but BTNZ's annual report showed a net surplus for calendar 1995 of NZ$24.15 million.
BTNZ's ultimate parent is Bankers Trust Co (BTC).
BTNZ said its tier one capital adequacy was 27.52 percent and its total capital adequacy was 29.23 percent.
It said it had no impaired assets and had made no specific provisions.
Peak end-of-day exposure to "connected persons" -- Bankers Trust Corp or its subsidiaries - totalled NZ$542.56 million or 337.32 percent of tier one capital as at June 30.
